channel.title: Sample Tech Feed
channel.description: A small bundled sample feed for offline use. Headlines are generic examples, not reports about real companies.

item.title: New open-source model cuts inference costs for small teams
item.description: A community-released model runs on a single GPU and uses less memory than earlier small models. Early testers report faster responses on everyday prompts.

item.title: New open source model cuts inference cost for small teams

item.title: Researchers release a toolkit for testing chatbot safety
item.description: The toolkit checks chatbots for rude replies, leaked instructions, and hallucinated facts. It ships with twenty ready-made test cases and a plain-text report.

item.title: Venture funding for AI tools stays strong this quarter
item.description: Investors continue to back small firms building tools on top of large language models. Founders say hiring for applied AI roles is still the main bottleneck.

item.title: Remote work tools see steady demand from small firms
item.description: Small firms keep buying scheduling and meeting software as hybrid work settles into a routine. Vendors compete on price and on simple setup rather than new features.

item.title: Astronomers spot a bright comet in the early morning sky
item.description: The comet should stay visible to the naked eye for another week before it fades. Observers in dark areas will have the best view just before dawn.

item.title: Study finds evening walks linked to better sleep
item.description: People who walked for thirty minutes after dinner fell asleep faster in a small study. Researchers caution that the result needs a larger trial to confirm.

item.title: City library extends weekend hours for students
item.description: The main branch will now open two hours earlier on Saturdays and Sundays during exam season. Staff say the change follows a survey of student visitors.
